text: Read carefully the letter addressed to Elena in the Reading Booklet Insert. Then answer Section 1,
Question 1 on this Question Paper.
Imagine that you are Elena and you are going to answer Freya’s letter.
Write your letter, which will be published in the magazine.
In your letter you should:
• identify and evaluate Freya’s arguments and concerns
• give Freya suitable advice for her situation.
Base your letter on what you have read in the passage, but be careful to use your own words.
Address each of the two bullet points.
Begin your letter, ‘Dear Freya,
I was sad to read your letter and I understand your feelings. However, I am sure that your situation
is not as hopeless as you imagine…’.
Write between 1½ and 2 sides, allowing for the size of your handwriting.
Up to 10 marks are available for the content of your answer, and up to 15 marks for the
quality of your writing.
[Total: 25]
Section 2: Composition
Write about two sides, allowing for the size of your handwriting, on one of the following questions.
Up to 13 marks are available for the content and structure of your answer, and up to 12 marks
for the style and accuracy of your writing.
Argumentative/Discursive writing

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Would you enjoy being one of these: a teacher, a police officer or a doctor? Explain why or
why not.
OR

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
‘Getting old is something to be dreaded.’ Do you agree?
Descriptive writing

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe a classroom of students with no teacher present. End your description as the
classroom door suddenly opens.
OR

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
You climb a tree and cannot be seen. Describe what you see and hear happening below.
Narrative writing

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Write a story which begins with the words ‘Nothing could have prepared me for what I had to
do next.’
OR

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
You have the power to go back 24 hours to change what happened or what was said. Write a
story involving this power, making it clear why you needed to make changes.
[Turn to page 6 to answer Section 2]
